reject: language-response targets as the reasoning objective
evaluation or authority material leaking into training

contract: Training cases encode projected epistemic state and a target TransitionProposal, not conversational prompt/answer text.
Evaluation executes predicted transitions through the same ConstitutionalVM used by the runtime.
Loss exposes illegal transition, missing transition, invariant violation, provenance loss, missing defeaters, improper scope, illegal authorization, belief corruption and replay mismatch separately.
Evaluation/history/authority/verification sources are never training inputs.
Specific training failure causes require evidence; otherwise classification remains unresolved_failure_cause.
Real weight mutation is not authorized until exact model, tokenizer, trainer, checkpoint, resource bounds, evaluator, competence baseline and transition path are explicitly bound.
